title: Elemental Origins
description: A mod that adds six elemental origin options to replace the original origins. Fire, Water, Nature, Air, Light, and Dark.
body:
This mod adds 6 elemental origins to replace the base origins. Air, Water, Fire, Nature, Dark, and Light.

Air

Gift of Flight- Blessed by the air, you gain the ability to fly and glide.

Speed of Wind- Using the wind, the air elemental can run faster.

Fragile- You have 2 less hearts than normal.

Soft Landing- You take no fall damage.

Water

Fast Swimmer- You glide through the water at top speeds.

Breath of Water- You can breathe underwater.

Water Sight- You can see clearly through water.

Flammable- You are sensitive to fire.

Fire

Fire Immunity- You are immune to fire damage.

Fire Healing- You heal faster while on fire.

Lava Walker- You can walk on lava as if it is a solid block.

Water Weakness- You take damage while in water.

Nature

Nature's Strength- You are have 2 more hearts than normal.

Vine Climb- You can use vine powers to climb walls.

Photosynthesis- While exposed to the sun, you have strength.

Vegetarian- You cannot consume meat.

Dark

Night Strength- You are stronger at night time.

Night Sight- You can see in the darkness.

Darkness Phase- You can phase through blocks by becoming darkness.

Light Weakness- You are slow when exposed to the sun.

Light

Day Strength- You are stronger at day time.

Light Feet- You fall slowly as you are light on your feet.

Glowing Aura- As a being of light, you glow at night.

Night Weakness- You are weak when it is too dark.

![An image of the selection for the air origin.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3cc0cb719835abd284c5bf784cfc08f3eb683650.png)
